name: Ilford FP4 Plus
notes: Characteristic curve: x axis is RELATIVE log exposure (frame 0 to 4.5, no absolute lux-seconds, no Log H Ref), y is density, frame bottom = density 0 (gridlines every 0.5, labelled 1.0 and 2.0). The sheet does not state the densitometry type; balance 'daylight' is the light of the ISO 125/22 speed rating ('speed rating of ISO 125/22 to daylight').

Only one curve: FP4 Plus roll film in ILFORD ILFOTEC HC (1+31), 8 min at 20C, intermittent agitation, said to represent 35mm and sheet film too. Traced as v; base+fog about 0.09 as read, curve stops at relative log exposure about 4.1 (shoulder near 1.87). The ISO speed itself was measured in ID-11 at 20C, a different developer from the curve.

Spectral sensitivity: sheet title 'Wedge spectrogram to tungsten light (2850K)', drawn as a line curve on a 'Sensitivity' axis with ticks 0.5 and 1.0 only. Traced as sensitivity/v with numbers as printed; the frame bottom is about -0.12 on that scale (not 0), scale is relative and linear/log is not stated, the curve runs about 364-668 nm.
No document code (footer 'Page n of 6, Nov 2018'), no granularity figure, no print recommendation on the sheet.
